# Decerna

> > Decerna is a UK-based consultancy specializing in decarbonisation, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), and low-carbon economy solutions for businesses and local authorities.

Decerna delivers energy efficiency programs like the SME Energy Efficiency Scheme (SMEES) funded by ERDF, conducts whole life carbon assessments per ISO standards and RICS 2024 guidance, and supports renewable energy projects including heat decarbonisation plans and carbon-negative housing developments like Sinclair Meadows.

## Key Topics

- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- Whole Life Carbon Assessment (WLCA)
- Decarbonisation
- SME Energy Efficiency Scheme (SMEES)
- European Regional Development Fund (ERDF)
- Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs)
- ISO 14040/14044 standards
- RICS 2024 guidance
- Heat pumps and renewable heating
- Carbon-negative housing
- Net zero strategies
- Energy efficiency for SMEs
- Heat decarbonisation plans
- Construction emissions reduction
- Grant funding programs

- [About us - Decerna](https://www.decerna.co.uk/about-us): About Decerna: decarbonisation and low-carbon economy consultancy

## Life Cycle Assessment & Carbon Standards

- [3. How do you do a Whole Life Carbon Assessment? - Decerna](https://www.decerna.co.uk/knowledge-base/life-cycle-assessment/wlca/how-to-calculate-whole-life-carbon): WLCA calculation guide using RICS 2024, EN 15978, and CIBSE TM65 standards
- [What is Attributional LCA? - Decerna](https://www.decerna.co.uk/knowledge-base/life-cycle-assessment/lca/what-is-attributional-lca): Attributional LCA methodology for EPDs per ISO 14044 standards
- [What is Consequential LCA? - Decerna](https://www.decerna.co.uk/knowledge-base/life-cycle-assessment/lca/what-is-consequential-lca): Consequential LCA methodology using marginal suppliers & system expansion
- [What are ISO 14065 and ISO 14066? Understanding Environmental Verification Standards - Decerna](https://www.decerna.co.uk/knowledge-base/life-cycle-assessment/iso-standards/iso-14065-and-iso-14066-understanding-environmental-verification-standards): ISO 14065 & 14066 environmental verification standards explained
- [What is ISO 14021? Decerna explains carbon footprinting](https://www.decerna.co.uk/knowledge-base/life-cycle-assessment/iso-standards/what-is-iso-14021-self-declared-environmental-claims-explained): ISO 14021 Type II self-declared environmental claims standard explained
